problem.title: Problem · {code}
problem.lead: One tap tells the team leader and the office. The work can go on.
problem.question: What is the problem?
problem.none: This site has no problems to tell from a phone yet. Ask your team leader.

ask.title: Ask · {code}
ask.lead: One tap asks. The answer comes back to this basket.
ask.question: What do you need?
ask.none: This site has no asks from a phone yet. Ask your team leader.

code.ASK_TO_PATCH: Send it to the patch team

ask.voiceLost: The voice note needs the network: it did not go. Tell your team leader what you need.
ask.voiceFailed: The ask went, but the voice note did not. Tell your team leader what you need.

window.offline: No network. Try again when the network is back.
window.offlineSaved: No network: one tap still works. It is saved on this phone and goes when the network is back.
window.notFound: This basket is not at this site.
window.forbidden: You may not do this here. Ask your team leader.
window.failed: It did not go. Try again.
window.already: Already told for {code}: the team leader comes.
window.saved: {what}: saved on this phone. It goes to the team leader when the network is back.

department.first: Pick your department first. One tap.
department.label: Departments
department.station: Where are you? Tap your place.
department.none: This department has no station at this site. Ask the office to add one.

card.label: Problem told
card.voiceTitle: A voice note about the problem · {code}
card.officeNote: Nobody came in time: the office is told.

state.OFFICE: It is at the office now

sent.voice: Voice note sent to the office.

spot.title: Show the place · {code}
spot.lead: Tap the place of the problem.
spot.shown: The problem is at place {no} of 9

photo.title: Photo · {code}
photo.saved: Photo saved. The office sees it.
photo.offline: Needs the network. A photo cannot wait on the phone: take it when the network is back.

notes.title: Notes from the office · {code}
notes.lead: The office's notes for this work, newest first.
notes.none: No notes from the office for this work.

me.title: Me
me.failed: Your team could not be read now.

me.waiting_other: Saved on this phone: {count} wait to go to the office.
me.offline_one: No network. Your work is saved on this phone: {count} waits.
me.offline_other: No network. Your work is saved on this phone: {count} wait.
me.myDayNote: My day is for your eyes only: it asks your PIN. My record shows one tick on this phone, two ticks at the office.

tell.title: Tell the office
tell.offline: No network: a message with your name waits on this phone; one without your name goes only with the network.
tell.privacy: Without your name, the office does not see who sent it.

held.kind: First tap what it is about.
held.empty: Say it in a few words or a voice note.
held.voiceOffline: A voice note needs the network.
held.anonOffline: A message without your name goes only when the network is there.
